description: This file defines classes and functions related to Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) parameter groups, communication context, and hooks for overlapping all-gather and reduce-scatter operations in distributed training within PyTorch's FSDP implementation.

classes.name: FSDPCommContext
classes.description: Manages communication streams and states for overlapping all-gather, reduce-scatter, and all-reduce operations in distributed FSDP training.

classes.name: AllGatherState
classes.description: Stores the result and synchronization event for an all-gather operation.

classes.name: ReduceScatterState
classes.description: Stores the input tensor and event for a reduce-scatter operation.

classes.name: AllReduceState
classes.description: Stores the input tensor and event for an all-reduce operation.

classes.name: FSDPParamGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of parameters to be communicated together in distributed FSDP, managing sharding, communication, and hooks.

classes.name: RegisterPostBackwardFunction
classes.description: Autograd function to register a callback for post-backward operations, triggering post-backward hooks and resharding.

methods.name: lazy_init
methods.description: Initializes communication streams and states, setting up overlapping streams for all-gather, reduce-scatter, and all-reduce.

methods.name: get_all_gather_streams
methods.description: Returns appropriate streams for all-gather operations based on async operation and training state.

methods.name: unshard
methods.description: Performs unsharding of parameters, initiating all-gather operations if needed.

methods.name: wait_for_unshard
methods.description: Waits for ongoing unsharding operations to complete, handling implicit and explicit prefetching.

methods.name: reshard
methods.description: Reshards parameters, either after post-forward or normally.

methods.name: pre_forward
methods.description: Prepares parameters for forward pass, unsharding if necessary.

methods.name: post_forward
methods.description: Handles post-forward logic, including resharding and recording post-forward usage.

methods.name: _record_post_forward
methods.description: Records the usage of a forward pass for post-forward management.

methods.name: pre_backward
methods.description: Prepares parameters for backward pass, unsharding if needed.

methods.name: post_backward
methods.description: Handles post-backward logic, including gradient reduction, resharding, and hook management.

methods.name: finalize_backward
methods.description: Finalizes backward pass, synchronizing events and clearing states.

methods.name: _wait_for_post_backward
methods.description: Waits for post-backward events to complete.

methods.name: _backward_prefetch
methods.description: Performs prefetching of parameters for backward pass.

methods.name: _prefetch_unshard
methods.description: Triggers unsharding of a target parameter group for a specified pass type.

methods.name: _to_sharded
methods.description: Converts parameters to sharded state.

methods.name: _to_sharded_post_forward
methods.description: Converts parameters to sharded state after forward pass.

methods.name: _to_unsharded
methods.description: Converts parameters to unsharded state.

methods.name: use_training_state
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set the training state.

methods.name: _register_post_backward_hook
methods.description: Registers hooks to trigger post-backward operations after backward pass.

methods.name: _register_state_dict_hooks
methods.description: Registers hooks for saving and loading state dicts.

methods.name: _with_fqn
methods.description: Returns a fully qualified name for logging or debugging.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the FSDPParamGroup.

methods.name: _validate_no_meta_params
methods.description: Checks that parameters are materialized from meta device before training.

methods.name: _validate_cpu_offload_params
methods.description: Checks that parameters are on CPU when CPU offload policy is enabled.
